0022600028.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-4, on a two-game losing streak) host the Utah Jazz (1-7, on a six-game losing streak) in the Mavericks' 9th game of the season and an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Dallas is 11th in the West and 5th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, while Utah is 14th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 5.5 games back. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2 and have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas won the last meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17, 2026.
